newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-FAI,Trump in talks on St Moritz hotel.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-FAI,Trump in talks on St Moritz hotel.

text.p: FAI Insurance Ltd (FAI) said it has successfully entered into a consultancy agreement with the Trump Organisation to examine development opportunities for its St Moritz hotel in New York.
"We anticipate that this will ultimately lead to a joint venture agreement with the Trump Organisation," said FAI chief executive Rodney Adler.
FAI acquired the 688-room St Moritz Hotel for US$175 million from Bond Corp Holdings Ltd in 1990 as a debt repayment.

"By entering into this arrangement with the Trump Organisation, we are parntered by one of the most experienced New York property developers who are well placed to analyse all the available options, develop and market the end product," Adler said in a satement.
"We believe this is very positive for the site as well as the FAI Insurance Group.
